items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: MCA had a guy by the name of Johnny Boswell that they were billing... Johnny Boswell is available, and Herbie ain't got a job.

ctx.x: Fort Dix, that's it. And he come out of the army, and he was running around with horns under his arms, jamming all over New York and upsetting everybody, and MCA had a guy by the name of Johnny Boswell that they were billing, and they sent a man out to (inaudible) Herbert Field up and sign him up. And they did. They signed him up to get him out of (inaudible) because he was running two, three around there, playing all them horns and exciting people.

So they put him in New Jersey at the Meadowbrook -- what is it? Daly, Frank Daly? Meadowbrook, and they had Herbert playing for air time. They bled Herbert and his mother's husband, who's a jeweler in Newark, New Jersey, out of $80,000.00. But they were doing all this. And Herbert, see, what was happening, in order to keep his band together, he would rehearse during the week. And what happened, instead of him paying full, he paid everybody half salary anyway because he was rehearsing them and they wasn't getting…
